en.shortDescription: Personal CRM to manage relationships and contacts
en.longDescription:
Monica is an open-source personal CRM for tracking interactions, reminders, and notes about friends, family, and colleagues.

Includes MariaDB. Register your account on first launch.

de.shortDescription: Persönliches CRM zur Verwaltung von Beziehungen und Kontakten
de.longDescription:
Monica ist ein Open-Source-persönliches CRM zum Verfolgen von Interaktionen, Erinnerungen und Notizen über Freunde, Familie und Kollegen.

Enthält MariaDB. Registriere dein Konto beim ersten Start.

fr.shortDescription: CRM personnel pour gérer relations et contacts
fr.longDescription:
Monica est un CRM personnel open source pour suivre les interactions, rappels et notes concernant amis, famille et collègues.

Inclut MariaDB. Créez votre compte au premier lancement.

pt.shortDescription: CRM pessoal para gerenciar relacionamentos e contatos
pt.longDescription:
Monica é um CRM pessoal open-source para acompanhar interações, lembretes e anotações sobre amigos, família e colegas.

Inclui MariaDB. Registre sua conta no primeiro acesso.
